commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP: pre-baseline =="
systemctl is-active ca-certificates 2>/dev/null || true
rpm -q ca-certificates
echo "boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"

echo "== STEP: create CA material =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/pki/CA/OSComparisonRootCA
cd /etc/pki/CA/OSComparisonRootCA

sudo -n openssl genrsa -out ca.key 4096 2>/tmp/genrsa.log

sudo -n openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key ca.key -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA/O=OS Comparison Root CA" \
  -out ca.crt

echo "== STEP: verify cert content =="
sudo -n openssl x509 -in ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates

echo "== STEP: install into system trust store =="
sudo -n cp ca.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
sudo -n update-ca-trust extract

echo "== STEP: verify trust installation =="
FP=$(sudo -n openssl x509 -in ca.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256)
echo "expected_fp: $FP"
BUNDLE_FP=$(awk 'BEGIN{c=0} /-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----/{c++} {print > ("/tmp/bundle_"c".pem")}' /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt; true)
grep -l "OS Comparison Root CA" -R /tmp/bundle_*.pem 2>/dev/null | while read f; do openssl x509 -in "$f" -noout -subject -fingerprint -sha256; done
rm -f /tmp/bundle_*.pem

echo "== STEP: trust list check =="
trust list 2>/dev/null | grep -A1 "OS Comparison Root CA" || true

echo "DONE"

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== anchors file present =="
ls -l /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt

echo "== grep bundle for CA name =="
grep -n "OS Comparison Root CA" /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt | head -5
grep -c "OS Comparison Root CA" /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt

echo "== extract cert from bundle and verify self-signed trust chain =="
awk '/OS Comparison Root CA/{f=1} f{print} /END CERTIFICATE/{if(f){exit}}' /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt > /tmp/extracted.pem
# find nearest preceding BEGIN
csplit -s -z -f /tmp/split_ -b '%02d.pem' /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt '/-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----/' '{*}' 2>/dev/null || true
for f in /tmp/split_*.pem; do
  if grep -q "OS Comparison Root CA" "$f"; then
    echo "--- match: $f ---"
    openssl x509 -in "$f" -noout -subject -fingerprint -sha256
    openssl verify -CAfile "$f" "$f"
  fi
done
rm -f /tmp/split_*.pem /tmp/extracted.pem

echo "== trust list (p11-kit) =="
trust list 2>/dev/null | grep -B1 -A1 "OS Comparison Root CA" || echo "trust cmd not found or no match"

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
cd /etc/pki/CA/OSComparisonRootCA

echo "== issue a test leaf cert signed by the new CA =="
sudo -n openssl genrsa -out test.key 2048 2>/dev/null
sudo -n openssl req -new -key test.key -subj "/CN=trust-test.example.com" -out test.csr
sudo -n openssl x509 -req -in test.csr -CA ca.crt -CAkey ca.key -CAcreateserial -days 30 -out test.crt -sha256 2>/tmp/sign.log
cat /tmp/sign.log || true

echo "== verify leaf cert against SYSTEM DEFAULT trust store (no -CAfile override) =="
sudo -n openssl verify test.crt

echo "== also explicit against default bundle path =="
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt test.crt

sudo -n rm -f test.key test.csr test.crt ca.srl
echo DONE
